checks.description: Named checks. Agents can only run checks listed here.

oneOf.description: A shell command run from the workspace root. Exit code 0 is a pass.

kind.description: "command" runs a shell command; "lean" compiles the claim's linked Lean declaration and fails if it uses sorry.

command.description: For "command": the shell command. For "lean": the Lean invocation, default `lake env lean` with a lakefile, otherwise `lean`.

permittedAxioms.description: Lean dependency allowlist. An empty list requires no axioms; omitted preserves the existing policy of rejecting sorryAx only. Changing this policy makes previous evidence stale.

inputs.description: Globs of files the check reads, such as tests and fixtures. Changing one makes earlier results of this check stale.

onStop.description: Keep agents working while their claims are not in an accepted status.

scope.description: Which claims the stop gate holds an agent to: "agent", the claims its session opened or changed (with hooks that cannot tell sessions apart, claims stated by agents); "all", every open claim.

accept.description: Statuses that discharge a claim. "proved" is a goal whose steps are all discharged.

unverifiedAgentCode.description: What `prooftree ci` does about agent-written lines that no person reviewed and no claim's passing check or approval covers: ignore them, annotate them as warnings, or fail the build.
